profile.headline: Software Engineer / SharePoint Developer / Creative Thinker / Problem Solver
profile.jobTitle: Software Engineer / SharePoint Developer / Creative Thinker / Problem Solver
profile.summary: I am an experienced Project Manager and front-end Web Developer in Oregon specializing in SharePoint 2010/2013 development and customization. I have over 13 years experience working with Intel, starting in 2000, and 20+ years of Web design and project management experience. I’ve developed  portals and tools in Intel’s custom SharePoint environments including complex workflows, advanced branding, and responsive design using JavaScript libraries, HTML & CSS. The Web portals and tools I build save users time and money and help them perform their work more efficiently, with fewer errors.

positions.title: Software Engineer / SharePoint Developer / Creative Thinker / Problem Solver
positions.description:
•	Start to finish custom tool development in SharePoint 2010 / 2013.
•	Implementation of self-generated and agency-provided designs in large scale enterprise SharePoint environments.
•	Usability and performance analysis of SharePoint tools and sites.

positions.title: Freelance Nation Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Design, analyze, develop and deploy Web portals and business tools in the Intel SharePoint environments (Collaboration, Application, & Business Intelligence; 2010 & 2013).
•	Collaborate and communicate with Subject Matter Experts, Business Analysts and team members, both locally and remotely.
•	Develop and document procedures and "Best Known Methods" (BKM).

positions.title: Digital Platform Support Specialist
positions.description:
•	Provide an extensive level of support for enterprise SharePoint 2010 sites.
•	Analyze, develop and implement new systems and modify existing platforms to meet the goals of the Global Leadership and Learning organization.

positions.title: Sr. Web / SharePoint Developer and Project Manager
positions.description:
•	Creat, maintain, and redesign SSG.Intel.com and other Intel intranet sites.
•	Build and deploy custom SP 2010 forms and complex workflows.
•	Manage and deploy high quality multimedia projects while exceeding customer expectations and meeting deadlines.

company.name: Intel Corporation (contract through Randstad, formerly Technisource)
